svg.text: Share of patients with an OncoKB driver (v7.5) in at least one member gene — drivers only, as Sanchez-Vega et al. counted curated oncogenic events. A pathway's
denominator is the patients profiled for at least one of its genes, so a panel that covers few members makes a pathway look rarer than a genome-wide assay would; each
member gene's own % is over the patients profiled for THAT gene. 206 member-gene slots were on no participating panel and are listed as not profiled rather than
counted as unaltered. Pathway membership is the paper's Table S3; a gene's pathway role (oncogene / tumour suppressor) is not used in the count. Two-sided Fisher
tests; q is Benjamini–Hochberg across the pathways drawn, and separately across every member gene tested.
